page: Microsoft Azure FX12mds is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the FXMDVS family. It is equipped with 12 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server features 252.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 21.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the instance includes a 516 GB SSD. It is also designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage volumes. The configuration does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses, and there are no onboard GPU accelerators.

The high memory density relative to the virtual CPU count represents a specific architectural tradeoff, prioritizing memory capacity over raw parallel compute scaling. This profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads, such as large in-memory databases, caching layers, and data analytics tasks that require substantial RAM but moderate processing power.
